openalex.disabled_reason: OpenAlex API requires an API key under the current 2026 access model; the production freeze is Crossref-only unless an explicit authenticated provider contract is added before screening.

retention_rule: Crossref retrieves the complete result sets for the five frozen nectar-robbing/robbery/robber(s)/floral-larceny title queries within 2000-01-01 through 2026-09-24. Results are deduplicated, then retained only when title or Crossref abstract contains a frozen nectar-larceny text stem. This text gate is outcome-blind and does not use geometry or effect direction. Known-direct DOI recall is a blocking validation.
deduplication_rule: otherwise normalized title plus publication year
formal_inference_gate: No recurrence statistic may open unless the frozen Crossref frame passes the known-direct DOI recall gate, every retained candidate is screened under the pre-existing geometry contract, duplicates are resolved, and all exclusions are recorded.
